name: Nuts For You
source:
Do you like Romance? Comedy? Adven- SQUIRRELS!

You’re a squirrel at a vacation park, here to chill out and meet some other squirrels. You start out at the Great Squirrel Log where you can grab a bite to eat, sip on a Squirltale, and maybe meet some locals. There's 5 fuzzy tailed-bachelors just waiting for you to get to know them. After that, who knows what you'll find? 

You may uncover mysterious pasts, family trauma, or popcorn addictions along the way. Each squirrel is just waiting to meet you and steal your heart, with their charming looks and witty banter. Go nuts, you may find the squirrel of your life! 

[From [url=https://scurry-squad-studios.itch.io/nuts-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
